resources.string: That file isn\'t a Gigometer backup

Gigometer collects location data to measure the miles you drive and record each trip\'s route, including when the app is closed or not in use, so drives are logged automatically. Your trips are stored only on this phone and are never uploaded or sold.

To start recording on its own when you drive — even when Gigometer is closed — Android needs location set to \"Allow all the time\". On the next screen choose \"Allow all the time\". You can still record trips manually without it.
Gigometer can\'t measure miles without location access. Turn it on in Settings › Permissions › Location.
Optional. Shown on the PDF mileage log you give your tax preparer.
